subject: COSTAR status: repro done, M5 scaling risk
body:
Hi Alina, Dmitri,

Repro milestone closed May 14: we match the paper's counterfactual estimation numbers on tumor growth and on semi-synthetic MIMIC-III within noise across the five seeds. Jorge's feature-store spike is about 70% done.

The risk is M5. Tumor growth and M5 both generate data on the fly, but M5 at our target horizon blows past the memory budget on a single A100 node - the encoder-decoder runs OOM above batch 64 unless we shard, and sharding the on-the-fly generator is real work, maybe 3 engineer-weeks. Options: (a) pre-generate M5 to disk like the MIMIC-III path and accept ~2TB of storage, or (b) cut M5 from the July eval sweep and ship with tumor + MIMIC-III only.

My lean is (a), its boring and it works. Need a call by June 12 or the ablation grid slips out of July.

Linnea
